name: Match exit works in one click from live play, pause and replay
Context loss during replay ends replay and requires Resume after restoration
Skipping or finishing a replay resumes the live match without a pause dialog
Automatic slow motion ignores light hits and heavy arena contacts
Unstick works for a robot without self-righting and preserves damage and match time
Weapon gauges and robot warnings report damage and reduced output
Nearby damaged robots keep separate warnings and hide them outside play
Both robots show numeric HP and speed, and hit numbers reflect actual losses
Damage bubbles suppress one-HP labels in live play and replay while retaining precise damage
A main impact is not followed by a stream of one-HP bubbles on either robot
Damage borders increase through seven tiers and respect reduced motion
Knockouts show the final motion and a replay before the result modal
Replay damage borders use recorded hit time without extra words
Repair update: result shortcuts, ring-out metrics, fast speed, tracks and visible hit bubbles
